products.name: S-Chem
products.description: For ground improvement, jet grouting, and DSM. Enhances the mixability of clay-rich, hard-to-treat soils and increases their final strength.
features: Turns stiff soil into fluid material without adding water
Simultaneous increase in strength (+73% vs untreated)

products.name: Deeper 25
products.description: Auxiliary agent for clay-based excavations. Prevents clay from sticking, eliminates clods, and significantly improves the strength of stabilized soil.

products.name: ACK1 - Super Retarder
products.description: Set-retarding dispersant for cement grout. Provides long-lasting fluidity, reduces bleed water, and ensures stable, high-quality ground reinforcement.

products.name: D-Retardant
products.description: A set-retarding agent for cement-soil mixtures, capable of delaying the setting time by up to 48 hours.
features: Perfect for large DSM columns and long tunnel sections

products.name: RAD
products.description: Supports rapid and plastic setting of cement grouts for ground anchors, performing effectively even in highly fractured ground.

products.name: D-Fluid
products.description: A high-performance superplasticizer that reduces the water content in cement grout. Improves fluidity while maintaining high strength.
features: Reduces water demand by up to 50%

products.name: Bentonite
products.description: High-quality natural clay minerals essential for constructing cast-in-place piles and slurry-supported diaphragm walls.

products.name: DK-Backfill
products.description: Instant gelation without pipe clogging - perfect annulus and tail-void filling in TBM and shield tunnelling.

products.name: DK-Repair Mortar
products.description: High-strength repair mortar - maintains shape, no sagging or dripping even on overhead and vertical surfaces.

products.name: Aquavisco
products.description: Zero particle segregation under water - concrete retains full cohesion. No clouding and zero environmental impact.

products.name: OP-Flow Series
products.description: Used in the OPT Jet method, OP-Flow improves grout fluidity, reduces slump loss, and enables uniform ground improvement.

variants.description: Dark-brown liquid - extreme fluidity at 300 l/min and uniform soil improvement.
Milky-white thixotropic liquid - instantly stops liquefaction and sudden viscosity increase in soft soils.
